text.intro: Good evening, and welcome. Before you take the stage, I have a few questions for tonight's program. Please answer aloud, in your own words.
text.q_name: To begin: what name do you perform under?
text.q_from: Where are you from, and whom do you represent this evening?
text.q_day: And what do you do professionally, outside of competition?
text.q_hero: Which artist has influenced you the most?
text.q_weak: Strictly between us: is there a subject you would prefer your opponents not raise?
text.q_last: Finally, do you have a statement for your competitors?
text.outro: That concludes our interview. Thank you for your time, and best of luck this evening.
